title: A Near-Infrared Luminescent 11-Metal Cd(II)–Nd(III) Nanocluster for the Rapid Excitation Wavelength-Dependent Detection of Rutin

material_class.structural_family: Cd6Nd5 Schiff-base nanocluster with Nd5(OH)3(OAc)6 core

synthesis.procedure: Triethylamine in EtOH (1.0 mol/L, 1 mL) was added to a 10 mL EtOH/MeOH (3:2) solution containing Cd(NO3)2·4H2O (0.20 mmol, 0.061 g), Nd(OAc)3·6H2O (0.20 mmol, 0.064 g), HL (0.20 mmol, 0.033 g), and HL′ (3-methoxysalicylaldehyde, 0.20 mmol, 0.030 g). The mixture was heated and stirred at ~80 °C for 30 min, cooled, and filtered. Yellow crystals of 1 formed from the filtrate after diffusion of diethyl ether vapor for 3 weeks. Yield 0.071 g (48% based on Cd(NO3)2·4H2O). Mp 235 °C (dec.).
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution reaction followed by diethyl ether vapor diffusion crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: After cooling, the solution was filtered. Yellow crystals of 1 were obtained from the filtrate after diffusion of diethyl ether vapor for 3 weeks.

properties.summary: Discrete NIR-luminescent Cd6Nd5 nanocluster (dimensions 1.0 nm × 2.2 nm × 2.2 nm). Under 395 nm excitation in CH3CN it shows Nd3+ NIR emission at 875, 1060, and 1335 nm (strongest 1060 nm, τ = 7.85 μs). Rutin quenches the 395 nm-excited emission (Ksv = 2.01 × 10^4 M−1; LOD = 5.98 μM) via inner-filter effect while a new 470 nm excitation band grows and 470 nm-excited NIR emission increases. The ratiometric I(Ex 470 nm)/I(Ex 395 nm) vs [Rut] third-order calibration enables quantitative rutin sensing in CH3CN and fetal calf serum with ~5 s response and good selectivity versus interferents.
